peg thesis
Contents of this appendix
The mechanism they identified ............................................................................................................................... 447
What the additional points changed ........................................................................................................................ 448

Source record: docs/studies/analysis/pulsechain_thesis_consensus_20261003.md.
The integrated pDAI accumulation-and-peg thesis
3 October 2026. Five model analysts, three review rounds, frozen evidence. All blockchain work remains
read-only.
The strongest integrated thesis is a coordinated reserve manager built around pDAI: use selected issuer
and collateral permissions to create existing pool-facing tokens, convert them through funded markets,
accumulate pDAI and neighboring stables, retain both payment and sale inventory, and replenish the
resources consumed by support. A private L2 could provide collateral and coordinate execution. PLS
proceeds could be redeployed through less attributable wallets before buying pDAI.
All five analysts support this conditional architecture, including assessment of the L2 branch before a
fresh transfer occurs. They do not conclude that the saved record proves one operator is already
maintaining a dollar peg. Their agreement is a convergence of reasoning on shared evidence, not a
calibrated probability of hidden intent or a guarantee of perpetual stability.
The maintained white paper (main paper) incorporates the result. This study records the method,
judgments, dissent and reproduction references; it does not duplicate the full contract appendix.
The mechanism they identified
The comparison rule is one normalized eligible pStable = one accounting unit, U. A cheap eligible
token can enter an accepting issuer and produce a scarce pool coin. The reverse route buys a cheap
issuer coin and redeems its funded underlying. These conversions move resources across markets and
change issuer supply. Receipt tokens and LP shares require exchange-rate normalization.
Proposed L2 vault receipt
          ↓
Authenticated destination representation
          ↓
Accepted collateral plugin / active issuer basket
          ↓
Existing local issuer coin ← permitted local issuance
          ↓
Funded issuer / pool pays pDAI, stables or PLS
          ↓
Spendable inventory + owned liquid capital
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 447

↓
Optional private PLS redeployment → gradual purchases
          ↓
Retained payment assets + retained pDAI
          ↓
Buy below target / sell above target → restore capacity
Authorized L2 instructions can direct the local policy separately.
A specific prospective branch uses a liquid L2 receipt, an authenticated destination representation, a
compatible Reserve collateral plugin and activated basket, and existing Reserve eUSD. That eUSD
enters its FRAXBP pool; funded pUSDC output can reach pDAI or PLS through further permitted markets.
The new representation stays behind the issuer, so this branch need not replace Curve's coin list. Origin
OUSD and mUSD use 3CRV and have different collateral rules. Source and destination addresses need
not match; the final accepted local identity matters.
This recipe combines demonstrated local components and specific authority paths with still-unverified
source interfaces. The smallest missing connection is an exact authenticated output that a functioning
local issuer accepts under effective governance. Source receipt rights, gateway mapping/minter,
collateral plugin, basket activation, pricing and counterasset funding remain separate requirements.
Copied Arbitrum administration does not confer Optimism/Synthetix permissions. The issuer audit
(Appendix 38) and control audit (Appendix 52) identify those distinctions.
The L2 can also coordinate local trades without importing new principal through authorized keeper keys
or a destination executor. Attestations authorize acceptance of state or delivery; they are distinct from
financial issuance. Neither alone supplies the resources that funded markets pay. Zero Portal caps are
changeable gates under sufficient authority, alongside other checks. The broken current sETH2
implementation and disabled ordinary Maker PSM remain specific route constraints.
Accumulation reduces competing sell inventory and builds offer inventory. Dollar support additionally
requires funded bids and asks at payment quantities tied to an independent, executable dollar valuation.
PLS, ETH or BTC may provide variable-price payment assets without universal fixed Ethereum
redemption. Common U accounting does not itself fix that dollar scale.
Every support trade need not profit. The consolidated portfolio must fund its policy and obligations.
Pledged collateral, receipts and free trading inventory cannot be counted repeatedly. Promised in-band
execution needs funding or intervention before or within the supported trade; correcting a quote
afterward cannot repair completed proceeds. Define trade size, costs, response time, cumulative flow
horizon and adverse reference/liquidity bounds. See managed execution and exits (Appendix 45).
What the additional points changed
PLS privacy: all analysts received the premise that native PLS is the practical privacy staging asset on
PulseChain. A visible PLS exit establishes immediate conversion, not final extraction. It can be followed
by obscured accumulation; it can also be followed by disposal. The review no longer treats a missing
direct proceeds-to-purchase trail as decisive against the thesis. Active deployment, anonymity depth and
relevant use remain unverified. The original T ornado ERC20 implementation shows that native-only
mixing is not a general technical requirement; this generic source does not establish a working
PulseChain token mixer.
Prospective L2: the analysts assessed the full source-to-issuer-to-market route, rather than
substituting a local-only minimum or demanding a completed transfer before discussing plausibility.
Identifiable upgrade, collateral and existing-token interfaces make it a serious construction to
investigate. That judgment does not promote the specified interfaces into installed deployments.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 448

Three-year ratio: the user reports increasing PLS per pDAI. If reconstructed, that supports relative
strength and is compatible with persistent demand or sellable-supply contraction, including
accumulation in other wallets. The frozen record contains no independently verified three-year series.
PLS weakness, liquidity changes and independent buyers remain alternatives. Dollars per pDAI equal PLS
per pDAI multiplied by dollars per PLS. The ratio alone identifies neither source funding nor dollar
appreciation. A short-run adverse trade in one pool does not refute the reported long-run trend.
Obscured ownership still permits measurement of exact-token purchases, issuer custody, pool reserves,
executable bid/offer depth and replenishment. Those effects need not identify a single human controller.
Review results and dissent
The five roles were mechanism, economics, routes, attribution and clarity. Round 1 used fresh contexts
and the frozen paper/evidence without peer reports. Round 2 challenged a shared synthesis with all
three user steering points and the five initial assessments. Round 3 challenged the revised integrated
thesis using the second-round assessments. Later rounds were informed rereading by the same reviews,
not independent new samples or actual human comprehension tests.
The final judgments were:
Fixed assessment Final judgments
A — Coherent conditional financing/arbitrage architecture 5 supported
B — T wo saved positive gas-adjusted closed local trades 5 supported
C — Saved evidence proves one current coordinated dollar-
peg campaign
5 unsupported
D — Equal local U mechanically establishes a dollar anchor 5 unsupported
E — Funded permissions and an external reference make a
bounded band testable
5 supported
F — Saved current state proves fresh private-L2 or Portal
funding
5 unsupported
G — L2 financing/orchestration can compose under the
specified interfaces and obligations
5 supported
H — A PLS exit alone does not establish final extraction or
exclude accumulation
5 supported
I — A verified rising ratio fits accumulation without
identifying buyer/funding/dollar gain
5 supported
“Unsupported” means not established by the saved evidence, rather than impossible. A/E/G support
qualified designs; H/I support qualified reasoning, not a mixer deployment or verified price series. Initial
A/E label differences were resolved by reading their explicitly conditional wording; no new operating
evidence caused that change. Raw round-1 counts remain preserved.
T wo reviews accepted the final draft as written. Three accepted its substantive architecture while
requesting narrow diagram, verification-language or execution-promise corrections. Those corrections
were incorporated: separate receipt, representation, issuer acceptance and existing output; identify the
payer and separate orchestration; mark unverified interfaces; distinguish supported execution from later
quote restoration. No unresolved contradiction was identified in the conditional architecture. This does
not justify calling deployment or every possible market scenario flawless.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 449

The remaining substantive dissent concerns interpretation. The same apparatus can support a peg,
monetize inherited resources, or run ordinary arbitrage. The saved mUSD and sDAI operations gain 
200,053.199510 PLS and 110.687385 PLS respectively after gas, but their closing assets do not
establish subsequent retained support. The sDAI operation sells all its minted pDAI. These are
compatible with later purchases elsewhere and do not prove them. Exact reconciliation is in the closed-
trade study (Appendix 25).
The most valuable next design evidence specifies the source-to-accepted-destination interface with
controllers and resource obligations. The most valuable behavioral evidence measures net retained
inventory and repeated dollar-responsive two-way support, followed by restored issuer/payment
capacity. Reconstructing the reported price/depth history would test whether accumulation explains its
trajectory. These tests remain useful without reconstructing every private wallet link.
Reproduction and preservation
The explicit experiment record is Research/experiments/pulsechain_thesis_consensus_20261003.json. Frozen inputs
and all fifteen Markdown/JSON assessments are in ignored artifacts/pulsechain-thesis-consensus-20261003/.
The batch includes all 69 prior study snapshots, the initial paper, round-specific synthesis inputs, user
steering, raw verdict counts, final corrections, generic privacy source snapshots and hash inventories. No
original archive or historical evidence identity was overwritten.
The initial paper hash is 3f64f670beec3a09b9301cbc8a3942cde3c46fe15dc523ed83f89ebf6f586c93. All 70 initial input
hashes match. Existing funding, route and shutdown inventories were rechecked: 80, 134 and 33
recorded hash entries respectively matched. The closed-loop verifier reproduced 132 checks from saved
inputs; economics and routes independently reproduced it. No new blockchain calls were needed for this
consensus review, and no application code changed.
python Research/scripts/analyze_pulsechain_arbitrage_and_shutdown.py \
  --input artifacts/pulsechain-arbitrage-and-shutdown-20261003 \
  --prior artifacts/pulsechain-equal-value-routes-20261003 \
  --output /tmp/pulsechain-consensus-loop-reproduction-20261003.json
The final local verification checks assessment schemas, source-reference hashes, frozen review inputs,
saved outputs and maintained-paper links. The original private recovery records, private continuity
notes, deferred-settlement discussion and research ZIP remain preserved under private-recovery-records.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 450
